description: How the workspace's accounts are doing: views and the change in posts' first-two-day views against the period before, followers by day (per account, network and in total), engagement, which formats and video lengths work, best times to post (with ready posting slots), top posts, series trends and up to five suggestions. Also each post's first day against the account's usual at the same age, the posts that brought followers, the same post's views on each network, hashtags that go with posts beating their usual, and audience where the network gives it. Numbers sync every few hours from Instagram (with account views, reach and link taps), TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Threads and Bluesky (no views); own_posts_record and account_stats_record fill gaps. next_steps is what to do next, best first: each apply is the exact call to make (tool and input); needs names what the person still gives (a new photo or video). ideas are the suggestions, each with its call where one acts on it.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
